item_text: I am someone who assumes the best about people
I believe that I am better than others
I get others to do my duties
I need a push to get started
I tend to lose control during emergencies
What happens to me in the future mostly depends on me
I feel relief rather than satisfaction after completing a task that required a lot of mental effort
I have not experienced many warm and trusting relationships with others
Some people wander aimlessly through life but I am not one of them
I refuse things that are bad for me
My work goes better in the afternoon than before noon.
Most people tend to get angry more quickly than I do.
In the last month, how often have you felt that things were going your way?
I get carried away when I am working.
